what: GPU palette quantisation and dither (web/shaders/dither) against the vendored f64 reference (web/shaders/reference/retro-dither.mjs, the author's retro-dither.js unchanged)
roadmap: M1 criterion 10: ordered modes bit-equal to retro-dither.js
compare: palette index per pixel; a mismatch is any pixel whose index differs
cases: every palette in [gameboy, cga, ega, pico8, nes, mono1] x every mode in [none, bayer2, bayer4, bayer8, noise, blue] x both plates at strength 1, plus pico8 bayer8 and noise at strength 0.7 and brightness 0.05
note: noise (IGN) and blue are held to the same bound although the roadmap only requires the ordered modes.
